column1: Main Quests are in order of completion while Side Quests are in alphabetical order (mostly). The quests that are grouped together in a box are chained Side Quests. Side Quests with a yellow background require a Main Quest to be completed or started to continue, and the ones with a purple background need a Side Quest to be completed to continue.
